mechanism: Adapalene (retinoid) increases skin irritation, photosensitivity, and potential for localized inflammation when combined with amoxicillin clavulanate, particularly if amoxicillin causes drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) or other cutaneous adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased skin irritation, erythema, and photosensitivity; advise strict sun protection and consider timing separation of topical adapalene application from oral antibiotic initiation if severe skin reactions develop.
